risks: Boolean token auth cannot distinguish principals; reconnect of a different principal into an old buffer is not prevented by current identityMatch checks.
Client-selected workspace routing and full-list broadcasts can leak private Project title/path even if future GetProject is protected.
Error whitelist silently degrades intended FORBIDDEN/WORKSPACE_MISMATCH to HANDLER_ERROR until both declarations and whitelist are migrated.
Local profile email, OrgMember.userId and invite userId override are not verified principal identity; importing them as authority would violate WP-01.
Local Project IDs, path-bearing LoadedProject and basename workspace scopes cannot be treated as service UUIDs or safe remote DTOs.
A private member/non-owner case is distinct from a no-membership case; fixture naming and visibility members versus owner-only bootstrap need explicit resolution.

Published full registration/completeness gates exceed bootstrap contract and can recreate a circular DAG if later generalized packages are silently required to start WP-01. Keep explicit dependencies empty and preserve missing full DoD honestly.
Migration table inventory omits transaction outbox/inbox despite normative durable event requirements; no future-table FK or fabricated migrator filename is acceptable.
Wire status enum and Rox2 canonical triad differ; unchecked adapters could label queued/unverified outcome applied/verified.
Shared Project tool/context consumers may retain private derived text in session/export; no source evidence here proves broad downstream cutover or WP-50 provenance complete.
useProjects can display previous scope data while fetching and stale asynchronous completions can overwrite newer scope; catch-to-empty hides denied/offline states.

All source hashes bind to inspected working-tree snapshots; wave0 edits invalidate affected findings and must be re-read, not assumed current. No product runtime behavior was verified in this preflight.
